title: Comparing selection within a qualified subset
description: You can follow a row filter into conditional group rates.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: qualified retains rows whose true_skill exceeds the supplied threshold. You calculate each group's selected mean within that subset.

steps.question: Are these rates computed over every applicant in df?
steps.answer: No. Only the filtered qualified rows contribute to the group means.

steps.description: The supplied output reports 0.845 for A and 0.378 for B. You see their A-minus-B difference printed as 0.467.
You plot the two rates as bars and add a reference line at their maximum. The text recording reports the rates but supplies no rendered chart.
